GOOD TO KNOW / 03

A few sweet
details.

Can I order online yet?

This is a preview of the Honey Fluff dessert collection. Online ordering isn’t available yet. Final products, pricing, and launch details will be added here when confirmed.

Where can I check ingredients and allergens?

Final ingredient lists and allergen information aren’t available yet. Don’t use the concept descriptions as ingredient or dietary guidance. Confirmed product labels will be added before ordering opens.

What kinds of treats are planned?

We’re exploring ice cream, chocolate, and cookies. Browse the collection to see flavour concepts and build your own shortlist of favourites.

How do my saved favourites work?

Tap the heart on any treat to save it in this browser. Your shortlist stays on this device when browser storage is available; it doesn’t create an account or place an order.
